verdict.rationale: Workable documents a no-code, branded, mobile-friendly careers page with custom layout, colors, fonts and media. It also offers an automatically updating branded job-list widget you can embed on your existing website, which partly covers publishing to your own site without engineering. However, hosting the careers page itself on your own custom domain is never documented. Missing for 10: explicit custom-domain hosting for the careers page, explicit statement that ATS jobs publish directly to the hosted page, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I get a hosted, branded careers page on my own domain — jobs publish to it straight from the ATS with no engineering work

citations.quote: Create a branded, mobile-friendly careers page with built-in search, filtering, and auto-fill applications without coding skills. Brand with custom layout, brand colors, fonts and media.
Embed an automatically updating, branded job list on your existing website using a simple, customizable widget.
